subject: Coachella 2027 tickets
query: when do coachella 2027 tickets go on sale
title: When do Coachella 2027 tickets go on sale? Nov. 13 at noon PT
answer: The remaining Coachella 2027 passes go on sale Friday, Nov. 13, 2026, at noon Pacific time (3 p.m. Eastern) at coachella.com. American Express card members get a presale one day earlier, Thursday, Nov. 12, at noon PT. Plain general admission is already sold out; GA with shuttle starts at $779 and VIP at $1,349.
body:
Coachella 2027 runs over two weekends, April 9–11 and April 16–18, 2027, at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, with nearly the same lineup both weekends. The lineup, announced Nov. 10, is headlined by Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA, with Daddy Yankee billed separately as a fourth headliner. Other names include Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Måneskin, Diljit Dosanjh, Tiësto, Martin Garrix and Kygo.

Many buyers already have passes: an advance sale in May, before any artists were announced, sold GA at $599 for Weekend 1 and $549 for Weekend 2, and those tickets are gone, as is the $49-down payment plan from that sale. What remains, per listings checked Nov. 12, is GA bundled with a three-day shuttle pass at $779 for either weekend and VIP at $1,399 for Weekend 1 or $1,349 for Weekend 2, fees included, plus $16 shipping per order. Car camping costs $160 per weekend plus local tax. Coachella does not sell single-day passes.

Sales go through the official site and AXS. Have your AXS account, payment card and billing address ready before noon PT, and note that the Amex presale requires an eligible American Express card at checkout; prepaid cards do not qualify. Passes are sold subject to availability, so the cheapest tiers can disappear within minutes.
in_the_news: Coachella announced its 2027 lineup on Nov. 10, 2026, and opens its next round of pass sales on Nov. 12 (Amex) and Nov. 13 (everyone).

faq.a: After the May sale sold out, remaining passes start at $779 for GA with shuttle and $1,349 to $1,399 for VIP, fees included.
April 9–11 and April 16–18, 2027, in Indio, California.
Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA, with Daddy Yankee as an additional headliner.

faq.q: What time does the Coachella presale start?
faq.a: The American Express presale starts Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, at noon PT (3 p.m. ET). The general sale starts Friday, Nov. 13, at the same time.

faq.q: Can you buy a one-day Coachella ticket?
faq.a: No. Coachella sells only weekend passes.
